readings.Aries: Forward movement is your default. Just confirm that forward is still the right direction. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Taurus: Something is being offered. Your instinct is to evaluate before accepting. The evaluation is taking too long. The timing is better than it feels.
readings.Gemini: You contain multitudes and you know it. Today, pick one and inhabit it fully. Say the thing you've been rehearsing.
readings.Cancer: The boundary you're reluctant to draw is the one you most need. Act from the calmest part of yourself.
readings.Leo: Your instinct to protect your reputation is understandable. It is occasionally more expensive than the alternative. Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Virgo: You have more compassion for imperfection than your reputation suggests. Show it. What worked before will not work the same way this time.
readings.Libra: You want harmony. You also want honesty. Today they are in conflict. Choose honesty. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Scorpio: Your perceptiveness is remarkable and occasionally used as a weapon. Today, use it as a gift. The window for this is shorter than it looks.
readings.Sagittarius: The philosophy you've been living by is due for an update. What do you actually believe now? Notice what hasn't changed, not just what has.
readings.Capricorn: The coldness others perceive is not who you are. It is how you move through uncertain terrain. Let someone know. Something small done consistently has more effect than something large done once.
readings.Aquarius: Your idealism is not naïveté. It is a choice. Keep choosing it, but with your eyes open. This situation responds well to direct engagement.
readings.Pisces: You dissolve into the spaces you inhabit. Make sure the space deserves you. Saying less will move this further than saying more.

Aries-Aries.synthesis: You both arrived wanting to lead. The negotiation of who does is where most of the energy goes.

Aries-Libra.synthesis: Unique compound formed. Properties unpredictable — explore with caution.

calculation_methods: Planetary longitudes: Jean Meeus 'Astronomical Algorithms' low-precision formulae (±1° accuracy)
Retrograde: computed from direction of longitude change vs previous day
Aspects: angular separation with standard orbs (conjunction 8°, sextile 6°, square/trine/opposition 8°, quincunx 3°)
Compatibility: element harmony base score + modality adjustment + date-seeded variance
Daily readings: deterministic date-seed (PRNG) selects from 60-entry per-sign pools + 30-entry suffix pool; 1,800 combinations per sign
